p_feste: Serracapriola celebrates its most heartfelt religious festivals with great devotion and popular participation. Three are the celebrations that animate the town throughout the year, gathering both resident and emigrated Serracapriola natives from all over Italy and the world.
fst_fortunato_p1: San Fortunato is one of Serracapriola's most venerated saints. His feast is an occasion for great spiritual devotion and popular celebrations that animate the streets of the village with processions, music and moments of communal prayer.
fst_fortunato_p2: The statue of the saint is carried in procession through the streets of the town amid the devotion of the faithful, with traditional chants and votive offerings that testify to the deep bond between the community and its patron saint.
fst_mercurio_p1: The feast of San Mercurio is one of the oldest and most deep-rooted celebrations in the tradition of Serracapriola. The warrior saint is venerated with great fervour by the population, who gather around his figure as a sign of protection and devotion.
fst_mercurio_p2: The celebrations include solemn liturgical ceremonies, the traditional procession with the saint's statue and moments of popular festivity with music, fireworks and the typical community spirit that characterises festivals in southern Italy.
fst_grazie_p1: The feast of Madonna delle Grazie is the most eagerly awaited event of the year for the people of Serracapriola. Marian devotion is deeply rooted in the town's identity and the celebration in honour of Our Lady of Grace represents a moment of intense spirituality and renewed community unity.
fst_grazie_p2: The procession of the Madonna, accompanied by devotional chants, flowers and candles, winds through the streets of the village in an atmosphere of recollection and joy. Many emigrants return to Serracapriola specifically for this feast, making the celebration even more special and well-attended.
fst_infiorata_p1: The Infiorata is one of the most evocative and spectacular events of the year in Serracapriola. On the occasion of Corpus Domini, the streets of the historic centre are literally carpeted with fresh flowers, coloured petals and natural materials arranged with great skill by the town's inhabitants to form extraordinary floral pictures on the ground.
fst_infiorata_p2: The town's districts compete to create the most beautiful carpets, depicting sacred subjects, local symbols and artistic compositions of great visual impact. Preparation lasts all night and at dawn the streets transform into an open-air art gallery, attracting visitors from all over the province and beyond. An unforgettable visual and human experience that bears witness to the creativity and community spirit of Serracapriola.
fst_palio_p1: The Palio delle Contrade of Serracapriola is one of the most original and beloved folk events of the Gargano. The undisputed star of the race is the donkey: the town's districts compete in a riding race that mixes competition, colour and humour in an atmosphere of good-natured local rivalry.
fst_palio_p2: Each district enters with its own rider and donkey, amid flags, drums and the enthusiastic cheering of the townsfolk. The race takes place through the streets of the historic centre, turning Serracapriola into a medieval stage of great spectacle.
fst_palio_p3: The Palio is not just a race, but a moment of strong community identity: winning for one's district is a source of pride for the whole neighbourhood, and the event draws a growing audience of curious visitors, tourists and fans of southern Italian folk traditions every year.
